image_description: A high-angle, symmetrical view of a church interior featuring a central stone altar. The altar is a raised rectangular structure with a white cloth covering the top surface and a wooden base. Behind it stands an ornate reredos with religious statues and a large stained-glass window above. Rows of wooden pews flank a central aisle leading to the altar. The architecture includes stone arches and columns.
